arms.description: question-slot completeness + role/phase binding check + scope stop; no cap below the native 1-to-8 range (answer_mechanisms/prompt_arm.json)
arms.user_instruction_suffix: 回答前在内部核对问题要求的全部必要信息位：所问主体、事件或阶段，以及问题明确要求的原因、关系、方法或对照双方。最终仍只使用原有动作和输出格式。先完整回答这些必要信息位；每条事实只保留直接解释这些信息位所必需的内容，不因为证据中出现相关背景就补写人物生平、其他场景或重复事实。逐条核对事实中的说话者、受话对象、施事、受事与所属阶段；不要把对话中的你、她或泛称人物跨段合并，也不要把同一名词在不同场景中的用途合并。没有明确身份连接时保持证据原有称谓，不补推姓名、上下级或因果时序。推测保留推测限定，直接动机不能被更早的推测或现象描述替代。遇到缺证时按原有协议处理，不能用相邻事件或无关背景填补。事实条数由覆盖全部必要信息位决定：不为凑数增写事实，也不为减少条数删去必要信息位，仍在原协议1至8条范围内。

invariants: All 20 documents byte-identical and in original order in both prompts; only the specified final-user instruction differs.
Keep original round, question and legal next_action schema. Existing 1-to-8 fact rule is unchanged; no hard 1/3/4-fact ceiling.
Same final adapter, tokenizer, numeric backend, decoder, EOS, cache, 1024 generation cap and per-question scheduling; preflight all context budgets before generating.
One native completion per planned task-arm. No retries, repairs, best-of, post-hoc sentence deletion or selective exclusions. Preserve failure receipts.
Pre-register packet/file hashes before human judgments; reviewers see neither model/arm/prompt condition nor historical grades. Style may still reveal condition: assess blinding limitations.

primary.metric: paired difference B-A in fraction of all planned questions with whole-answer correct content
primary.whole_correct: Defined by protocol_experiments/SLOT_RUBRIC.md (hash in frozen_inputs): all frozen necessary slots satisfied with their speaker/addressee/actor/identity/phase/modality qualifiers, no material error anywhere in the readable completion (required or extra), action appropriate.
primary.denominator: Every preregistered question-arm including execution failures; repeated round/evidence variants remain but are not independent questions.
primary.syntax: Malformed JSON is scored for readable whole-answer content. JSON validity, fact count, protocol action schema and citation binding are separate deployment diagnostics.
primary.execution_failures: Missing output, OOM, timeout, generation error and hitting length limit without EOS count as failures; do not repair or replace them.
primary.judge: Independent human reviewers using all20 evidence, predeclared necessary slots, then blinded adjudication of disagreements. Assistant-only provisional review must remain labeled non-independent.
primary.analysis: Report gained/lost/both-correct/both-failed and B-A; also equal-weight question-group result. No iid confidence claim for 46 rows/43 groups.

diagnostics: Required/core error vs unnecessary/extra-fact error vs necessary-slot omission, with claim locator and evidence rationale; never infer error from output length.
Role/recipient, phase/modality, unsupported assertion and contradiction are recorded separately; multiple causes may coexist.
Raw text length, generated-token count, JSON, action-schema/citation validity, EOS/length and resource failures are descriptive, not substitutes for content accuracy.
Per item: first_material_error_fact index and unnecessary_supported list (SLOT_RUBRIC §5) separate 'error after a sufficient prefix' from 'error in the core'.

Mechanism panels on dev46 positions (diagnostic only, not the primary metric). v2: clear_clean_prefix [10,13,16,30,32,35,41] (6 question groups), first_fact_or_core [21,22,27,45] (answer_mechanisms/README.md). Input-layer: clean-prefix-then-error only [15,24,26,38]; its other 18 non-complete answers fail at facts 1-2 or by omission (input_errors/README.md). Both panels: late_necessary [1,17,31] must keep facts beyond the first relevant one; action_risk [4,5,12,19,43] (teacher label retrieve/abstain, both historical adapters answered).

Secondary outcome, per arm and panel: parsed next_action distribution (answer_directly / retrieve_more / abstain / unparsed), computed by analyze. A slot-focused instruction may push toward answering; report B-A shifts on action_risk positions separately. A justified 2/2 abstain on a question with no determinable content counts as correct (SLOT_RUBRIC §4).

mechanism_predictions.falsifier: Extra errors persist in those positions under B, or B shortens answers but the errors move into the core slots.

Expected input-layer B-A smaller than v2's.

decision_rule.development_pilot: Run each panel on the full 46 (all retained). Per panel advance only if gained > lost and extra-error reductions exceed new omissions. The objective (28/46 on the best adapter) is read only from the input-layer panel; a v2 gain alone does not meet it. Dev46 is reused development data and cannot establish generalization.
decision_rule.confirmation: Freeze wording and code before generating 120 new independent question families from source families excluded from training and repeated dev46. Balance role/recipient, stage/modality, multi-slot partial-answer and ordinary controls (30 each). Prepare slots and acceptable uncertainty/actions before seeing outputs. Two blinded human ratings per item, adjudicate all disagreements; 240 outputs plus adjudication. If source-family exclusion cannot be checked against complete1117, label the set unverified and do not claim independent testing.
decision_rule.confirmation_success: Positive whole-answer B-A with positive paired question-family bootstrap 95% lower bound (10000 resamples, seed20261025) and no increase in omission item rate; this is a conservative decision criterion, not a power guarantee. If interval spans zero, more evidence is needed, not success by fact count.
decision_rule.secondary_only_after_first: If B leaves core binding errors (second prediction falsified), the next training comparison follows data_mechanisms/BINDING_TARGET_SPEC.md (forward-only binding probe first, then matched-count training arms). If omissions dominate, use the reviewed slot-complete target contract in data_mechanisms/README.md. Never combine with LR or architecture changes. No merge or training authorized here.
